title: Speed limit in cities and towns
text: Unless a sign tells you otherwise, the speed limit within cities and towns is 50 km/h.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Speed control - Appropriate speeds', p. 69

title: Speed limit outside cities and towns
text: Unless a sign tells you otherwise, the speed limit outside cities and towns is 80 km/h.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Speed control - Appropriate speeds', p. 69

title: Two seconds of space in front
text: You need at least two seconds of space between your vehicle and the vehicle in front in good weather and road conditions.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Space margins - Space in front - the two-second rule', p. 73

title: Three seconds on high-speed roads
text: Increase your following distance to three seconds on high-speed roads.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Space margins - Space in front - the two-second rule', p. 73

title: Uncontrolled intersection, another vehicle arrived first
text: At an uncontrolled intersection, if another vehicle has arrived at the intersection before you, you must slow down and yield.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Types of intersections - Uncontrolled intersections', p. 41

title: Uncontrolled intersection, simultaneous arrival
text: At an uncontrolled intersection, if two vehicles arrive at the same time, the vehicle on the left must yield to the vehicle on the right.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Types of intersections - Uncontrolled intersections', p. 41

title: Complete stop at a stop sign
text: A stop sign always means that you must come to a complete stop.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Intersections controlled by stop signs', p. 45

title: Stop before the stop line
text: If there is a stop line you must stop just before the line.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Stopping at intersections', p. 42

title: Steady red light
text: A red light means that you must come to a complete stop.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Intersections controlled by traffic lights - steady red light', p. 43

title: Wait for green before proceeding straight
text: You must wait for the light to turn green before you go straight ahead.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Intersections controlled by traffic lights - steady red light', p. 43

title: Travel in a right-hand lane on a multi-lane highway
text: On a multi-lane highway you should travel in one of the right-hand lanes.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Using lanes correctly - Which lane should you use?', p. 49

title: Lane choice on a freeway with more than two lanes each way
text: When you are on a freeway with more than two lanes in each direction you should drive in the centre lane or a right-hand lane.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Using lanes correctly - Which lane should you use?', p. 49

title: One metre when passing a vulnerable road user
text: You must leave at least 1.0 metre of space when passing a cyclist, pedestrian, or other road user such as those using a personal mobility device.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Space margins - Space beside', p. 74

title: 1.5 metres above 50 km/h
text: On roads with speed limits above 50 km/h you must leave at least 1.5 metres when passing a vulnerable road user.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 5 see-think-do, 'Space margins - Space beside', p. 74

title: No passing a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk
text: Do not pass if you see a vehicle stopped at a crosswalk.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 6 sharing the road, 'Pedestrians - Scan at crosswalks and intersections', p. 83

title: Check the crosswalk before entering it
text: Do not enter a crosswalk without checking to see that it is empty, even when the light is green.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 6 sharing the road, 'Pedestrians - Scan at crosswalks and intersections', p. 83

title: All traffic must stop for an emergency vehicle
text: When an emergency vehicle displaying flashing lights and sirens approaches, all traffic moving in both directions must stop.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 6 sharing the road, 'Emergency vehicles', p. 93

title: Pull over to the right for an emergency vehicle
text: Pull over to the right and stop for an approaching emergency vehicle, or to the left if you are driving in the left lane of a divided highway or on a one-way street.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 6 sharing the road, 'Emergency vehicles', p. 93

title: U-turn that interferes with traffic
text: A U-turn is illegal if it interferes with other traffic.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'U-turns', p. 52

title: U-turn on a curve
text: A U-turn is illegal on a curve.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'U-turns', p. 52

title: No parking on a sidewalk or boulevard
text: It is illegal to park on a sidewalk or boulevard.
source: ICBC, Learn to drive smart, ch. 4 rules of the road, 'Parking tips and rules', p. 58
